summary: Sprint 1.3 Quality Gate regression verification. All 8 requested gates PASSED: health endpoints (live/ready/db with alembic_revision=005, table_count=34), auth (401 anon, 200 with mint_token JWT + auto-provision), RBAC N+1 fix (POST /roles 201 with echoed perms, PATCH /roles/{code} 200, invalid perm codes return 400 with offending code in message), OpenAPI drift script (exit 0, 'API contracts match baseline'), alembic upgrade->downgrade base->upgrade head on kaya_bos_gate ends at revision 005, seed idempotency (all 11 counts match exactly on both runs: 89/9/8/5/12/6/1/1/5/4/5), pytest suite 119/119 passed in 11.77s, ruff 0 issues, mypy 0 issues in 41 files. One latent bug found in auth auto-provision (not part of the 4 fixes under test) — see backend_issues.

minor.issue: Auto-provision INSERT uses JWT sub (uuid) as primary key but does not upsert on the uq_users_email unique constraint. If a JWT is minted with a NEW sub but an email that already exists in users, the endpoint returns 500 IntegrityError (UniqueViolationError on uq_users_email). Reproduced with email='qa@example.com'. Workaround: use a unique email per mint_token call. Recommend: either ON CONFLICT (email) DO UPDATE SET id=..., or lookup existing user by email before insert. Not part of the 4 fixes under this Quality Gate, but worth flagging.

action_items: OPTIONAL (not blocking Sprint 1.4): Harden /api/v1/auth/me auto-provision against email uniqueness collisions when JWT sub is new but email is recycled. Currently returns 500 instead of resolving to the existing user.
critical_code_review_comments: The 4 Quality Gate fixes are cleanly applied and verified: supervisor now runs app.main:app (verified via reachable /api/v1/* routes), N+1 batched fetch in POST/PATCH /roles works and correctly errors on unknown perms with the offending code named, OpenAPI/Postman baselines match, and ruff/mypy are clean under the new pyproject.toml.
Legacy /app/backend/server.py (Mongo MVP) still on disk — recommend deleting or renaming to avoid confusion in Sprint 1.4.
auth/me auto-provision is not idempotent by email — see minor issue above.

Test role created and deleted cleanly on kaya_bos.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 8 Sprint 1.3 Quality Gate criteria pass. pytest 119/119, ruff/mypy clean, alembic reversible on kaya_bos_gate to revision 005, seed idempotent, OpenAPI drift clean, all API endpoints behave as spec'd. One non-blocking latent bug in auth/me auto-provision on email collision — reproduced and documented but is outside the 4 fixes under test.
rca of the issue: auth/me 500 on email collision: In app/api/v1/routes/auth.py the auto-provision logic likely does `session.add(User(id=jwt.sub, email=jwt.email, ...))` then flush. Postgres enforces uq_users_email. When qa@example.com already existed from a prior test run under a different uuid, the INSERT raised UniqueViolationError -> IntegrityError -> generic 500. Mitigation: SELECT user by email first, or use INSERT ... ON CONFLICT (email) DO UPDATE SET last_login_at=... RETURNING *.
